snippet.title: Dream of Things Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930950/Dream_of_Things/

Dream of Things, a first-person puzzle game developed over several years by solo developer studio Tear Bird and published by indienova, is set to launch on Steam today. The game is priced at $9.99, with a 10% launch discount for the first two weeks.

Dream of Things is a first-person puzzle adventure set in a mysterious mansion where you wake up already dead, with no memory of who you are. Strangely, a mobile phone allows you to speak with everyday objects, each hiding its own puzzle-filled world and pieces of your forgotten past.

The game features five interconnected rooms, each forming a chapter filled with environmental storytelling and distinct household items that serve as the basis for puzzles. Some can be solved within a single room, while others require cross-room exploration, emphasizing spatial connections.

As you uncover hidden items and unravel complex chain-reaction mechanisms, you gradually piece together the truth behind your death and the world around you. Blending surreal narrative, intricate logic puzzles, and immersive exploration, Dream of Things offers a uniquely atmospheric and emotionally resonant experience.
